arrival.text: Look at that tiny rover! I almost missed it between the rocks. Let's take a scan.

scan.text: I'm Sojourner. I arrived on Mars with the Pathfinder lander in 1997.
I was the first rover to explore Mars. My six wheels carried me from rock to rock so I could take pictures and study what they were made of.
I stayed near Pathfinder. It passed my findings on to Earth.
My mission was meant to last just seven days. I kept exploring for almost three months.
Then Earth lost contact with Pathfinder, and my team could no longer receive my reports.
What they learned from my journey helped them prepare for other rovers to explore Mars.

reaction.text: So small, and it helped the next rovers get started. I'm glad I spotted it.

wrap_up.text: I've saved your story, little rover. Time to find the next one.
